mapper.sql: id, public_no, market_id, run_id, original_option_id, correct_option_id, fee_rate, total_amount, user_count, reason, status, created_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settle_compensation (public_no, market_id, run_id, original_option_id, correct_option_id, fee_rate, total_amount, user_count, reason, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{marketId}, #{runId}, #{originalOptionId}, #{correctOptionId}, #{feeRate}, #{totalAmount}, #{userCount}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO settle_compensation_item (compensation_id, market_id, user_id, should_payout, actual_payout, amount, created_at) VALUES
(#{i.compensationId}, #{i.marketId}, #{i.userId}, #{i.shouldPayout}, #{i.actualPayout}, #{i.amount}, #{i.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, compensation_id, market_id, user_id, should_payout, actual_payout, amount, created_at FROM settle_compensation_item WHERE compensation_id = #{compensationId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT FROM settle_compensation ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT id, status, winning_option_id, fee_rate FROM settle_run WHERE market_id = #{marketId} AND kind = 'PAYOUT'
SELECT position_id, user_id, option_id, stake, payout FROM settle_item WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY user_id, id
